title: Rename a setting and change its unit, without breaking old configs
prompt: Rename the `timeout` setting to `timeoutMs`, in milliseconds (a positive whole number). Config files that still say `timeout` (in seconds) must keep working for now, with one deprecation warning, the way `retry` is already handled; if both keys are there, timeoutMs wins. On the command line it becomes --timeout-ms, and --timeout keeps working the same deprecated way.
